notes.content:
[h2][b]Features[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*]Added different weapon pack
[*]Hamster can be thrown now
[*]Ragdoll receives force up on dying
[/list]

[h2][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*]Change grenade ammo
[*]Grenade doesn't push player away anymore if throwing and walking

[/list]
